evidence_receipt.claim: HookCaller._remove_plugin removes every hook implementation registered by the plugin.
evidence_receipt.expected_stdout_contains:
remaining = [impl for impl in self._hookimpls if impl.plugin != plugin]
if len(remaining) == len(self._hookimpls):
    raise ValueError(f"plugin {plugin!r} not found")
self._hookimpls[:] = remaining
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: If any hook implementation registered by the plugin remained in self._hookimpls after _remove_plugin, the claim would be false. The code replaces self._hookimpls with only those not belonging to the plugin, ensuring all are removed.
